contracts.protected_resource: CeSemesterTask rows and the student PII they contain.
contracts.protection_obligation: Course-eval object-level ownership for agent tools: a logged-in non-admin operator (identity taken from the agent tool runtime context) must not read or modify any CeSemesterTask whose owner_user_id differs from the operator's; all course-eval read/write agent tools converge on this single authorization point, and guest/anonymous/unauthenticated contexts are rejected outright.
scope_limits: Admins (admin/superadmin/super_admin roles per _is_admin_role) are exempt from the ownership restriction.
Guest/anonymous/unauthenticated runtime contexts are rejected before any query (_shared.py:31-33, docstring at 44-45).
Identity comes from the agent runtime context (runtime_context.user_id/role), not from client-supplied headers.
